name: wordpress-server-ops-beta
responsibility: Package reusable server-phase guidance for the WordPress Server Ops role in the co-installed WESEO WordPress/WST workflow: Remote-SSH setup, Project Context, server safety, WP-CLI/cache, media, content, commit trailer convention, frontend onboarding, project Cursor Rules cleanup, and project Cursor Rule authoring for projects that use the co-installed `wordpress-server-ops`, `wst-builder`, and `frontend-design-qa` plugins.
assumptions: The plugin is used from a Cursor workspace connected to a WordPress root or equivalent server-side project checkout.
For the full WESEO WordPress/WST delivery workflow, this plugin is expected to be co-installed with wst-builder and frontend-design-qa.

Project-specific URLs, server hostnames, WordPress roots, handoff storage locations, WP-CLI commands, cache commands, editable path exceptions, upload policies, and access setup live in the project-local PROJECT-CONTEXT.md or concrete handoffs.
Server-side WordPress, PHP, ACF, WST, WP-CLI, content, and media work can hand off to local frontend implementation through the Section or CPT handoff contract.

rules.name: server-phase-boundary
rules.description: Define which work remains in the server phase and which work hands off to local frontend implementation through Section or CPT handoffs.

rules.name: webroot-safety
rules.description: Prevent scratch, export, and temporary artifacts from being created inside a public WordPress root.

rules.name: file-edit-boundary
rules.description: Keep file edits inside project-approved WordPress paths and use project context for exceptions.

rules.name: plugin-package-boundary
rules.description: Keep required Server Ops workflows self-contained inside the plugin package and prevent development-only path or project-value dependencies.

rules.name: wp-cli-cache
rules.description: Document WP-CLI and cache expectations using project-local command placeholders.

rules.name: wordpress-content-editing
rules.description: Guide safe WordPress REST and ACF Flexible Content updates without project-specific layout lists.

rules.name: programmatic-acf-db-writes
rules.description: Prevent programmatic ACF field-definition writes and direct database writes from deleting shared ACF clone source fields: treat field-list reads as read-only, require snapshot, dry-run, idempotency, and rollback, and route WST/ACFE clone specifics to the wst-builder acf-wst-patterns Rule.

rules.name: commit-trailer
rules.description: Apply the SmartFlow commit trailer (`Made with: SmartFlow`) when creating commits. Migrated from the retired smartflow-tracer plugin.

skills.name: setup-orientation
skills.description: Guided German wizard for the complete first setup of a WESEO WordPress/WST Remote-SSH workspace: plain-language setup explanations, WordPress root detection, Project Context creation as required contract, Section/CPT handoff storage, LEARNINGS.md status, WST stack verification, Bitbucket Git access via hidden terminal prompt, restrictive .gitignore with tracked .cursor skeleton, WP-CLI and cache flush, co-installed workflow skill verification, required untracked MCP config for WordPress and Figma, safe temp policy, mandatory frontend onboarding handoff, and a non-technical setup summary before technical completion details.

skills.name: wp-media-import
skills.description: Import media through WP-CLI with reusable filename, metadata, verification, cache, and cleanup steps.

skills.name: project-rules-cleanup
skills.description: Guided German wizard for cleaning up legacy `weseo-smartflow-frontend-guide` Cursor Rules and locally accumulated `.cursor/rules` in projects that now use the co-installed `wordpress-server-ops`, `wst-builder`, and `frontend-design-qa` plugins. Audits Rules first, classifies them, migrates clearly non-secret project values into `PROJECT-CONTEXT.md`, warns when more than two Rules use `alwaysApply: true`, and deletes generic legacy Rules only after explicit confirmation. `.cursor/skills` is audited read-only and never deleted by this Skill.

skills.name: project-rule-authoring
skills.description: Guided German wizard for authoring a new project-local Cursor Rule in a WESEO WordPress/WST project. Wraps the generic Cursor `create-rule` flow with a short grill, a reuse check against the co-installed `wordpress-server-ops`, `wst-builder`, and `frontend-design-qa` plugins, a carrier decision between Rule, Skill, `PROJECT-CONTEXT.md`, and existing plugin guidance, and an `.mdc` frontmatter and `alwaysApply` hygiene validation step before any file is written.
